faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about our premium hardwood charcoal
faq.pageSubtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about our WOODEN WEST hardwood charcoal
faq.firstQuestion: What are the benefits of using WOODEN WEST hardwood charcoal?
faq.firstAnswer: Our WOODEN WEST hardwood charcoal has high thermal efficiency, long burning time and minimal ash content. It is made from quality wood and complies with European standards EN 1860-2.
faq.secondQuestion: How should I store hardwood charcoal?
faq.secondAnswer: Hardwood charcoal should be stored in a dry, ventilated place protected from moisture. It is best to keep it in the original packaging or an airtight container.
faq.thirdQuestion: How long does hardwood charcoal burn?
faq.thirdAnswer: Burning time depends on the fraction and conditions, but quality hardwood charcoal from WOODEN WEST burns for 2 to 4 hours, providing stable temperature.
faq.fourthQuestion: What fractions of charcoal do you offer?
faq.fourthAnswer: We offer various charcoal fractions, including the standard 20-120 mm fraction, which is ideal for grilling and barbecuing.
faq.fifthAnswer: We deliver charcoal with our own transport throughout Poland and EU countries. Delivery terms comply with INCOTERMS 2020 (DAP Polkowice).
